title: A skew Murnaghan--Nakayama rule for Hopf dual pairs
summary: We develop a uniform skew Murnaghan--Nakayama theory for graded Hopf dual pairs equipped with a nondegenerate Hopf pairing. Using the completed Cauchy element, its grouplike factorization, and the resulting partial contraction operators, we establish a general skew Cauchy identity together with an abstract skew Murnaghan--Nakayama rule. Specializing this framework recovers and extends the classical skew Murnaghan--Nakayama rule for symmetric functions, and yields new skew Murnaghan--Nakayama formulas in several settings, including the dual pairs $(\mathrm{NSym}, \mathrm{QSym}) $ and…
